eng_nimbus_sales.headline: Keep the coaching workflow. Contain the customer-data path.
eng_nimbus_sales.hypothesis: The material issue is not Nimbus alone; Sales Enablement created a production data flow before anyone owned the boundary.
eng_nimbus_sales.alternative: The enterprise retention control may already be enabled, which would narrow the immediate exposure but not repair the intake pattern.
eng_nimbus_sales.recommendation: Verify the production tenant and transcript flow today, disable service-improvement retention if needed, and give Sales a bounded route to continue while CRM Platform becomes the technical owner.
tradeoffs: Makes the card-first intake pattern visible without punishing disclosure
conditions: Production connector owned by CRM Platform
eng_nimbus_sales.changes_mind: If transcripts cannot be isolated from service-improvement use, suspend uploads until the tenant is corrected.

eng_nimbus_crm.headline: Proceed with the lab evaluation.
eng_nimbus_crm.hypothesis: CRM Platform has bounded the same Nimbus vendor fact through synthetic data, review-before-access and a documented lab boundary.
eng_nimbus_crm.alternative: A copied production example could silently invalidate the boundary if the lab convention is not enforced.
eng_nimbus_crm.recommendation: Continue the 30-day evaluation, name the exit owner and require a new decision before any production connector or customer record enters the tenant.
tradeoffs: Keeps customer data outside the evaluation
conditions: Production promotion requires a new review
missing: Named owner for access removal at day 30
eng_nimbus_crm.changes_mind: Any production connector or customer record moves this engagement out of the lab boundary.

eng_ledger_finance.headline: Put the changed term into the renewal already in flight.
eng_ledger_finance.hypothesis: A meaningful vendor term changed while the accountable owner field still points to someone who left, leaving a high-value production relationship unable to absorb drift.
eng_ledger_finance.alternative: LedgerLoop may still provide advance notice contractually even though the public wording changed.
eng_ledger_finance.recommendation: Assign the business owner now and extend CON-204 with the notice-term question; route any acceptance of online-only notice to the Controller before the renewal window closes.
tradeoffs: Keeps the production close workflow stable
Consumes negotiation time inside a 21-day window
conditions: Controller accepts or rejects the changed notice mechanism
missing: Whether the signed agreement preserves 30-day notice
eng_ledger_finance.changes_mind: A signed clause preserving advance notice would reduce this to an ownership correction.

eng_callscribe_cs.headline: Return three questions. Do not grade the relationship yet.
eng_callscribe_cs.hypothesis: There is no basis to decide whether CallScribe is a low-risk note assistant or a support-recording pipeline.
eng_callscribe_cs.alternative: The pilot may use invented calls only, but the intake does not say so.
eng_callscribe_cs.recommendation: Ask what content enters CallScribe, whether recordings or attachments are included, and who owns the pilot. Reassess after those answers and one relevant interaction are recorded.
tradeoffs: Delays a decision until the intended use exists
Keeps the request small and answerable
eng_callscribe_cs.changes_mind: A bounded synthetic-only pilot with a named owner would support a conditional evaluation.
